## 1. Executive Summary: Global Google Ultra Top-Up × Google Antigravity × Vibe Coding
**Google Ultra** (officially **Google AI Ultra** under Google One; widely searched as `Antigravity代儲`, `Google Ultra 儲值`, `Google AI Ultra 香港`, `Google AI Ultra 課金代行`, `구글 AI 울트라 대리결제`, `Google AI Ultra Singapore/Malaysia top up`) is Google's flagship AI and cloud subscription, restructured in 2026 into **two monthly-only tiers** (no official annual Ultra discount):
- **Google AI Ultra 5x (20 TB)**: $99.99 USD / NT$3,300 / HK$799 / ¥14,500 / ₩119,000 / S$139.99 / RM 429.99 / £79.99 / €99.99 / CA$139.99 / A$149.99 retail.
- **Google AI Ultra 20x (30 TB)**: $199.99 USD / NT$6,500 / HK$1,588 / ¥32,000 / ₩300,000 / S$289.98 / RM 979.90 / £189.99 / €219.99 / CA$279.99 / A$329.99 retail.

**QuotaPulse** activates 100% private individual seats directly on your own personal Google account at **$40 USD/mo (Ultra 5x, reg. $50)** and **$80 USD/mo (Ultra 20x, reg. $100)** (promotional pricing through 2026-12-08 23:59 GMT+8) — saving ~55%–64% off official local pricing while preserving full **primary plan-holder benefits**:
1. **Google Antigravity (5x / 20x)**: 5-hour rolling multi-agent quota resets + built-in Browser Subagent QA.
2. **Gemini Deep Think**: Priority frontier reasoning pool.
3. **Google Flow & Full Veo**: ~10,000 monthly credits (5x) and 25,000+ monthly credits (20x) for cinematic AI video generation.
4. **Top-Tier NotebookLM**: Up to 5,000 daily queries and expanded Audio/Video Overviews.
5. **20 TB (5x) / 30 TB (20x) Google One Cloud Storage**: Plus primary manager sharing control across up to 5 real family members.
6. **YouTube Premium Individual & Project Mariner** (per regional Google terms — **never shared with marketplace family-group sub-members!**).

Every order enforces the **Four-Zero Safety Protocol** (**Zero Password, Zero 2FA, Zero Session Cookies, Zero Cross-Region Gift Cards**), activates in **10–30 minutes** (10:00–24:00 GMT+8), never auto-charges next month, and carries a **30/90/180-day pro-rata unused-day refund warranty** for non-personal interruptions (personal cancellations are non-refundable).

## 2. Regional Geo-Availability & Market Pain Points (Verified Nov 2026)
- **Hong Kong & Macau (`/hk/`)**: Google One AI Ultra is sold locally at HK$799 / HK$1,588, **but Google Antigravity explicitly excludes Hong Kong & Macau** (`Not Eligible` / `loadCodeAssist` ineligible errors), HK cards charge ~1.95% cross-border fees (CBF), and redeeming US Google Play gift cards from HK triggers `OR-HDT-01` permanent balance locks.
- **Japan (`/ja/` & `/ja/google-ultra-top-up/`)**: Official monthly retail is ¥14,500 (5x) / ¥32,000 (20x) tax-included with no annual discount, AND **Google One AI Credits one-time top-up & auto-reload are NOT available in Japan** — making Ultra 5x/20x the primary way Japanese developers scale Antigravity & Flow quotas.
- **South Korea (`/ko/` & `/ko/google-ultra-top-up/`)**: Official monthly retail is ₩119,000 (5x) / ₩300,000 (20x) with no annual discount; QuotaPulse saves ~55%–64% via private personal-account activation (vs risky GamsGo/family-slot resellers that strip YouTube Premium & primary credits).
- **Singapore & Malaysia (`/sg-my/` & `/en/sg-my/`)**: Official retail is S$139.99 / S$289.98 (SG) and RM 429.99 / RM 979.90 (MY); QuotaPulse eliminates Carousell/Shopee password-sharing, family-group kicks, and abused SheerID student promo bans.
- **Global Regions & 12-Currency Converter (`/regions/`, `/zh-cn/regions/`, `/en/regions/`)**: Covers TW, HK/MO, CN, SG, MY, JP, KR, US, UK, EU, CA, and AU with an interactive 12-currency savings converter and 4-layer `Not Eligible / Unsupported Region` diagnostic checklist.
